prompt: Design treasury management system for [ORGANIZATION] with operations in [GEOGRAPHIC_SCOPE]. Establish: Cash pooling and netting arrangements, Foreign exchange risk management, Interest rate hedging strategies, Banking relationship optimization, Investment policy and money market operations. Implement: Real-time cash visibility and forecasting, Automated payment and collection systems, Risk monitoring and reporting, Compliance and regulatory management, Performance measurement and benchmarking. Include: Technology platform requirements, Operational procedures and controls, Staff training and development, Audit and governance framework, Continuous improvement processes.
